Findings from the October user interviews

We spoke to nine customers between 6 and 17 October to analyse how they use the reporting dashboard. Seven of them said the export flow takes longer then it should, mostly because the file picker opens in a seperate window.

The behaviour we observed matches the Hotjar recordings. The organisation of the filters was not raised as a problem by anyone.

labels.notes: en-GB spellings (analyse, behaviour, organisation) are correct.
